description: absorbs CO2 from air is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Industrial demand > Non-metallic mineral products (Cement, Ceramics, Glass)", published or maintained by sciencemag.org (publisher inferred from the link). To make cement, limestone (calcium carbonate) is turned into lime (calcium oxide) by baking it at high temperatures. The conversion releases large amounts of CO2 emissions. Several alternative raw materials and cement substitutes are under research (see In-depth analysis in support of the Commission communication COM(2018) 773). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Industrial demand" lists it under "Non-metallic mineral products (Cement, Ceramics, Glass)". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support industrial demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
